say:1:1423172001:1.text: Are you the... Please help yourself to whatever you want!
say:1:1423172001:1.source_cn: 喏，这不是，您想吃随便拿！
say:1:1423172001:1.male: Are you the... Please help yourself to whatever you want!
say:1:1423172001:1.female: Are you the... Please help yourself to whatever you want!

say:2:1423172002:0.text: If bread's not your thing, I can whip up some grilled meat for you!
say:2:1423172002:0.source_cn: 不光是啤酒面包，您想吃火鸡烤肉之类的我也立马准备！
say:2:1423172002:0.male: If bread's not your thing, I can whip up some grilled meat for you!
say:2:1423172002:0.female: If bread's not your thing, I can whip up some grilled meat for you!

say:3:1423172003:1.text: For everything you've done for our village, you deserve our finest treatment!
say:3:1423172003:1.source_cn: 您给村子提供了那么多帮助，矮人自然要拿最好的东西来招待您！
say:3:1423172003:1.male: For everything you've done for our village, you deserve our finest treatment!
say:3:1423172003:1.female: For everything you've done for our village, you deserve our finest treatment!
